title: LNA reasoning-loop trajectory row
description: One JSONL row appended per loop step to /kaggle/working/trajectory/<run_id>.jsonl. Every phase of the loop (consult..edit) emits at least one row; a candidate is checkpointed after each phase so a session timeout loses nothing. Evidence fields (error_verbatim) are stored UNTRUNCATED (house rule: never summarize evidence).

run_id.description: Unique id for one driver invocation; also the JSONL filename stem.

iteration.description: 0-based candidate index within the run (a single-round loop uses one iteration per proposal).

phase.description: Which funnel stage produced this row.

model_id.description: LLM model id/name that produced the text for propose/diagnose/edit phases (null for deterministic phases). e.g. 'qwen3-30b-a3b-q4_k_m' or 'dryrun'.

prompt_tokens.description: LLM prompt token count for this phase (from the server usage field), else null.

completion_tokens.description: LLM completion token count for this phase, else null.

consult_hits.description: playbook --consult --json output (list of {id,score,rule,...}) attached on the consult phase.

proposal.description: The LLM's proposed (or edited) circuit and its stated reasoning. Present on propose/edit.

netlist.description: The proposal netlist text VERBATIM as the model emitted it (before parsing).

rationale.description: Free-text reasoning the model gave for the topology choice.

predicted_deltas.description: The model's PREDICTED metric outcomes/changes, keyed by metric (nf_db, s11_db, s21_db, idd_ma). On propose: predicted absolute values or 'expected feasible' deltas. On edit: predicted CHANGE vs the previous candidate. Recorded so prediction-vs-outcome is a first-class field.

roundtrip_ok.description: Did proposal.parse + to_tokens + Topology succeed? Set on the roundtrip phase.

wl_hash.description: Weisfeiler-Lehman graph hash of the parsed topology (novelty.wl_features). Stable identity across netlist orderings; the join key to any stored label.

l0_pass.description: spec.structural_screen result on the screen phase.

l0_criteria.description: The per-criterion screen dict {has_transistor: bool, device_budget: bool, ...} for diagnosability.

bias_conducting.description: Did bias insertion produce a sizable two-port deck (not skipped)? Set on the bias phase. A learning signal on whether the topology can even be biased.

sized.description: Result of the sizing phase (the solve_spec size_tokens code path).

feasible.description: Did the best sized point meet every gated constraint?

margins.description: spec.margins_for(best_metrics): per-constraint {achieved, required_min, required_max, scale, margin, supported}. margin>=0 iff satisfied. The learning target.

metrics.description: Raw measured metrics at the best point (nf_db, s11_db, s21_db, idd_ma, ...).

n_evals.description: ngspice evaluations spent on this sizing.

seed.description: CMA-ES seed that produced the best result.

diagnosis.description: On the diagnose phase: the LLM's reading of the margin table + op summary (which constraint binds and why, what to change). Free text.

next_action.description: The loop's decision after this row: e.g. 'edit', 'accept', 'reject', 'give_up', 'retry'. Drives the trajectory graph.

prediction_vs_outcome.description: Joins the proposal.predicted_deltas against the measured sized.metrics/margins for this candidate. {metric: {predicted, measured, error}}. First-class field: the loop's self-calibration signal.

error_verbatim.description: VERBATIM, UNTRUNCATED simulator/parser/round-trip error text when a phase fails. Never summarized. Null when the phase succeeded.

ts.description: Unix timestamp (seconds, float) when this row was emitted.
